title: Working with received documents
summary: Documents a vendor shared that are waiting to be booked into the system.

steps.text: Use {imp} to bring in a document a vendor shared with you, then book it once it is reviewed.
Click a document in the list to open it and read its lines before you book it.
You can also ask the assistant to list what was received, book a received document into your records or mark it reconciled. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
